answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Every value is more extreme than the fine-tuned range and beyond or at the edge of the system-prompted range. Top-1 agreement is 0.828 (system-prompted 0.861-0.908, fine-tuned 0.900-0.938), sequence agreement is 0.281 (system-prompted 0.31-0.48), KL is 0.432 (system-prompted 0.197-0.339, fine-tuned 0.081-0.205), TV is 0.173 and Token-DiFR gap is 0.845. The raw-score shift/TV of 3.1 is consistent with system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and the low end of fine-tuned (3.1-10.8). Quantized is ruled out because KL and TV are far above its range of 0.039-0.071. Fine-tuned is unlikely because the divergence is much larger than any seen in that category. The values overshoot the system-prompted range somewhat, so some uncertainty remains, such as a stronger fine-tune or a more intrusive system prompt.
